```{r}
 # Q1
head(msleep)
data("msleep")

msleep |> filter(awake>=12) |> select(awake)

```


```{r}

# Q2

percent_day_awake <- msleep |> mutate(percent_day_awake = (awake/24*100)) |> 
select(percent_day_awake, everything()) 

percent_day_awake

```




```{r}
# Q4

head(storms)
data("storms")

storms |> filter(wind>50) |> arrange(desc(wind))
```


```{r}
 # Q3

data("storms")

storms |> group_by(year) |> summarize(num_storms=n())

```
